sources.quote: Famous trekking areas like Mustang, Muktinath, Kali Gandaki valley and Mt Dhaulagiri fall in this zone.
The gorge separates the major peaks of Dhaulagiri (8,167 m or 26,795 ft) on the west and Annapurna

facts.rationale: Resolved supported. Wikipedia Dhaulagiri_Zone (quote verified) places Mt Dhaulagiri in that pre-2015 zone (same status as the region label both labellers accepted as acceptable_historical, not false), and Kali_Gandaki_Gorge puts Dhaulagiri on the gorge's west side. 'Northwestern Nepal' is loose (zone was in the Western Development Region; Britannica says west-central) but not a contradiction of the location.
